title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions in the theme's look, shown going from the sample clip to a graphics frame: seven of its own (a paper panel sliding up, a brushed reveal, a soft cross-zoom with a cream light leak, a cream dissolve, a blur-through, an arch window, a collage of drifting photos) and five calm ones from the shared set, drawn in the theme's colours (cream rims on pale paper). Keep them slow (0.6-0.9 s); most cuts in this style should stay plain cuts or use the cream_flash effect.
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "paper_slide", "seconds": 0.8}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "cream_zoom", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.6}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl); this theme's own shaders and its colours for the shared ones are in transitions/theme_transitions.py.

items.name: cream zoom
items.description: A gentle push through the shot into the next while a cream and sun-yellow light leak drifts across. The theme default.

items.name: cream dissolve
items.description: The shot washes out to cream paper, highlights first, and the next comes up out of the cream, its darker shapes first.

items.name: blur through
items.description: The shot goes softly out of focus, becomes the next while both are a blur, and comes back into focus.

items.name: warp wipe
items.description: A soft cream edge sweeps across on a diagonal, bending the picture slightly as it passes.

items.name: paper slide
items.description: A paper panel carrying the next shot slides up over the old one and settles, a cream mat on its top edge and a soft shadow ahead of it.

items.name: brush reveal
items.description: The next shot is brushed on in five broad, soft strokes from alternating sides, each leaving a pale cream edge.

items.name: arch reveal
items.description: An arch-topped window rises from the bottom and widens until it is the whole picture, the next shot inside a cream mat.

items.name: page turn
items.description: The old shot lifts from a corner and curls away like a pale page, the new one lying underneath.

items.name: collage split
items.description: The frame comes apart into square-cornered photos with paper gutters; they drift up and away, turning a little and fading.

items.name: slice slide
items.description: The old shot is cut into horizontal strips that slide off to alternate sides, like collage strips being cleared.

items.name: swing doors
items.description: The old shot splits down the middle and swings open like two doors onto the new one.

items.name: accordion fold
items.description: The old shot folds away toward one edge in four vertical panels, uncovering the new one.
